mapper.sql: select release_accumulate, reduce_target_amount, pay_status, create_date, hash, id, order_no, user_id, days, usdt_value, valid_num1_value, last_ftn_price, have_valid_num1, status, create_time, pay_time, update_time, remark, biz_status, is_reduced from t_destroy_order
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.usdt_value), 0) AS team_today_performance FROM t_destroy_order o INNER JOIN t_user_relation r ON o.user_id = r.pos_user_id WHERE r.active_flag = 1 AND r.par_user_id = #{userId} -- 这个是团队上级 AND r.distance > 0 AND o.status in (1) -- 只算已生效/已支付订单 AND o.create_date = #{intDate}; -- 例如 20251118

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.usdt_value), 0) AS team_month_performance FROM t_destroy_order o INNER JOIN t_user_relation r ON o.user_id = r.pos_user_id WHERE r.active_flag = 1 AND r.par_user_id = #{userId} AND r.distance > 0 AND o.status in (1) AND o.create_date >= #{monthStart} AND o.create_date <= #{monthEnd}

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.usdt_value), 0) AS totalUsdt, COALESCE(SUM(o.valid_num1_value), 0) AS totalValidNum1 FROM t_destroy_order o INNER JOIN t_user_relation r ON o.user_id = r.pos_user_id WHERE r.active_flag = 1 AND r.par_user_id = #{userId} AND r.distance > 0 AND o.status IN (1) AND o.create_date = #{intDate}

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.usdt_value), 0) AS totalUsdt, COALESCE(SUM(o.valid_num1_value), 0) AS totalValidNum1 FROM t_destroy_order o INNER JOIN t_user_relation r ON o.user_id = r.pos_user_id WHERE r.active_flag = 1 AND r.par_user_id = #{userId} AND r.distance > 0 AND o.status IN (1) AND o.create_date >= #{monthStart} AND o.create_date <= #{monthEnd}
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(valid_num1_value), 0) AS total_valid_num1 FROM t_destroy_order WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 1;
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(valid_num1_value), 0) AS total_valid_num1 FROM t_destroy_order WHERE status = 1;
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(valid_num1_value), 0) AS total_valid_num1 FROM t_destroy_order WHERE status = 1 AND create_date = #{today};

select id, days, usdt_value as usdtValue,valid_num1_value as validNum1Value,have_valid_num1 as haveValidNum1, status, create_time as createTime, is_reduced as isReduced from t_destroy_order where user_id = #{userId} and status = 1 order by id desc
